messages:
Nina (growth): quick pitch  tie the starter-prompts credit to our May webinar. registrants who attend + complete the 3-template walkthrough in 48h get a 50-credit bonus on top of the standard 75. helps webinar->trial activation and gives a clear bench for the launch post.
Owen (demand-gen): good headline potential: 'Build a demo in 48h + credits'. we can run two landing variants: product-first vs outcome-first.
Priya (analytics): metric ask: primary = registrant -> active trial (>=1000 tokens in 7d). secondary = trial->paid 14d and d7 retention. instrument events: webinar.registered, webinar.attended, walkthrough.started, walkthrough.completed, credits.granted. Add campaign_variant dimension.
Carlos (eng): infra plan: onboarding-service will tag users and call /campaigns/grant with variant and TTL for bonus credits. need idempotency key + abuse detection. sample payload planned.
Hannah (support): note from past promos: users asked about expiry and why bonus didn't apply. propose clear modal copy + FAQ. set alert if support mentions spike >2x.
LegalBot: Promo terms reminder: credits are non-transferable and expire per campaign. include abuse clause and link to legal template.
notion-bot: Notion doc created: /Marketing/experiments/may-webinar-credit (owner: Nina)
Nina (growth): rollout plan: start 5% sampling of eligible registrants for 72h to validate instrumentation, then ramp to 25% if no issues. budget: 150k credits.
Owen (demand-gen): I'll own landing + paid promo. Hannah can we get support snippets for the FAQ?
Hannah (support): yes, drafting responses for "why didn't I get the bonus" and "when do credits expire".
Priya (analytics): I'll add the funnel dashboards and power calc. rollback rules: cost-per-conversion > $150 or support tickets >2x baseline. also monitor fraud metric.
Carlos (eng): ETA: grant endpoint + webhook to webinar provider in 2 days, UI flagging + modal in 3 days. will open PRs today.
Nina (growth): action items: Owen = landing + promos, Priya = dashboards + event spec, Carlos = grant + webhooks, Hannah = support docs, Legal = promo text approval. sync Fri 11am to review early signal.
Owen (demand-gen): small ask: can we add a CTA in the webinar slide deck to guide attendees to the walkthrough? will coordinate with content.
Nina (growth): yes, let's make the webinar a direct path to TTV. if we see lift we'll use counts & % lift in the launch post and bench messaging. excited to test. :rocket:
